color.note: Dark-first, zero-chroma canvas. One accent at a time, drawn from the official Base palette. Dark is the primary theme; a value missing from light inherits dark.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground: every screen background. Pure black in dark, paper white in light. On the website use `web-bg` instead.

tokens.name: web-bg
tokens.usage: Website page ground (cofferdam.xyz). The one exception to pure black: lifted to #0a0a0a so the translucent sticky nav still separates from the page. Matches the site's themeColor.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surface one step from `bg`: sheets, drawers. Light mode steps down to a cool off-white so sheets separate from the page.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Two steps from `bg`: nested panels, chips inside a card, avatar and initials fills, the website's secondary fills.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles (vault cards, 2×2 home tiles, site value tiles). White in light mode — it reads against `surface`/`surface-2` grounds and by its `card-border`.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around `card`. Structure only, never the only cue that something is tappable — use `border-control` for that.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Structural, decorative border: dividers between groups, in-flight status chips, panel edges. Not for controls.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of anything interactive that has no fill: secondary buttons, inputs, checkboxes, segmented controls. ≥3:1 on `bg`, `card` and `surface-2` in both themes.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: List separators and section rules.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `card`. Also the fill of the primary button (white-on-black in dark, near-black in light).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg`, `surface`, `card` (≥7:1 in both themes). Ghost buttons, captions, bottom chips.

tokens.name: fg-muted-2
tokens.usage: Tertiary metadata only. Below 4.5:1 in the source (dark 4.2:1 on `bg`, 3.7:1 on `surface-2`; light 3.5:1 on white, 3.0:1 on `surface-2`): text 24px+ or non-essential hints, never body copy.

tokens.name: fg-dim
tokens.usage: Disabled and ghost states. Not for readable text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The proof accent, meaning only: verified ticks, live/active state, the Ready chip, focus rings, the site's proof signal. One token, two values: Base Blue in light (8.6:1 on white), Cerulean in dark (6.3:1 on black) — Base Blue is forbidden on dark. For brand identity (icon, splash, logo glow) use `identity`, not `accent`.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Low-alpha accent fill behind accent text: Ready chip, verified pill, logo glow. Runtime-picked accents derive it at 0.14 alpha.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Mid-alpha accent hairline paired with `accent-dim`. Runtime-picked accents derive it at 0.32 alpha.

tokens.name: identity
tokens.usage: The identity blue in both themes: app icon and splash ground (light), logo glow, brand illustrations and the cover. Never used for text or proof states — that is `accent` (Base Blue in light, Cerulean in dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and failed states, independent of the accent. Text on `bg` and `surface-2` (≥8:1 dark, ≥4.7:1 light). Always pair with a word or icon. Light value darkened from #D92B1A in v4 so it holds 4.5:1 on the new `surface-2`.

tokens.name: danger-dim
tokens.usage: Low-alpha fill behind `danger` text: the Failed chip, error banners.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Hairline paired with `danger-dim`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution and testnet markers. Light value is 3.3:1 on white and 2.9:1 on `surface-2`: icons and 24px+ text only in light, always with a word.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Semantic success, never the brand accent. Light value is 4.3:1 on white, 3.8:1 on `surface-2`: bold 19px+ or with an icon. Pair with a word or icon; it differs from `danger` by hue, not lightness.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notes and links inside notices. Text on `bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dimming layer under sheets and modals.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Heavy dimming for full-screen takeovers (document scanner, face and fingerprint sign-in prompts).

tokens.name: glass-scrim
tokens.usage: Translucent layer over the blur on the glass fallback (Android, web, iOS < 26) so labels stay legible. Liquid Glass ignores it.

tokens.name: chain-tile
tokens.usage: ChainLogo mainnet tile behind the Base Square. Light value matches `surface-2` so the tile reads on white.

tokens.name: chain-tile-testnet
tokens.usage: ChainLogo testnet (Sepolia) tile.

tokens.name: chain-tile-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline edge of the testnet tile.

tokens.name: chain-mark
tokens.usage: The Base Square inside chain badges and ChainLogo: white on dark, black on light. Never blue in product UI — blue is reserved for proof (`accent`). The blue Square belongs to Base's own lockups and partner credits.

tokens.name: base-blue
tokens.usage: Official Base Blue (locked). Light surfaces only: the brand forbids it on dark (2.4:1 on black). Light default accent; the Base Square on light.

tokens.name: base-cerulean
tokens.usage: Official Base Cerulean (locked). Dark default accent, Base Blue's dark counterpart. 3.4:1 on white: marks only in light.

tokens.name: base-tan
tokens.usage: Official Base Tan (locked). Accent option. Dark scheme only for text (2.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: base-yellow
tokens.usage: Official Base Yellow (locked). Accent option; also the warning family. Dark scheme only for text (1.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: base-green
tokens.usage: Official Base Green (locked). Accent option. Dark scheme only for text (2.1:1 on white). Not the success colour.

tokens.name: base-lime
tokens.usage: Official Base Lime Green (locked). Accent option on dark only (16:1 on black, 1.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: base-red
tokens.usage: Official Base Red (locked). Accent option; danger family. 5.9:1 on black; 3.6:1 on white, marks only in light.

tokens.name: base-pink
tokens.usage: Official Base Pink (locked). Accent option on dark (11.7:1 on black, 1.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: self-teal
tokens.usage: Self.xyz's teal: their identity, not ours. Only inside the Self mark/card and as the last accent option (an homage). Never a Cofferdam primary.

tokens.name: splash-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the app icon and the launch splash (and the native splash colour, so frame 0 matches). Cerulean in light, deep navy in dark. The icon and splash are the only full-colour fields in the brand; product screens stay on `bg`.

tokens.name: splash-gradient-from
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the splash/icon gradient (fades in over `splash-bg`). Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: splash-gradient-to
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of the splash/icon gradient. Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: mark-a-stem
tokens.usage: v5 mark, bracket A stem. Light value sits on the Cerulean icon/splash ground (not white surfaces — use the single-ink mark there); dark value on navy or black.

tokens.name: mark-a-arm
tokens.usage: v5 mark, bracket A arm — the lightest face, kept just below white so the top doesn't outshine the bottom bracket.

tokens.name: mark-b-stem
tokens.usage: v5 mark, bracket B stem — the deepest face. Light value for the Cerulean ground only.

tokens.name: mark-b-arm
tokens.usage: v5 mark, bracket B arm. Light value for the Cerulean ground only.

tokens.name: mark-mono-a-stem
tokens.usage: Greyscale v5 mark, bracket A stem. For white and surface grounds (light value) or bg (dark value), the tinted/mono app icon and greyscale print. Same tone order as the colour mark, kept to a tight range.

tokens.name: mark-mono-a-arm
tokens.usage: Greyscale v5 mark, bracket A arm. For white and surface grounds (light value) or bg (dark value), the tinted/mono app icon and greyscale print. Same tone order as the colour mark, kept to a tight range.

tokens.name: mark-mono-b-stem
tokens.usage: Greyscale v5 mark, bracket B stem. For white and surface grounds (light value) or bg (dark value), the tinted/mono app icon and greyscale print. Same tone order as the colour mark, kept to a tight range.

tokens.name: mark-mono-b-arm
tokens.usage: Greyscale v5 mark, bracket B arm. For white and surface grounds (light value) or bg (dark value), the tinted/mono app icon and greyscale print. Same tone order as the colour mark, kept to a tight range.

tokens.name: tile-mono-from
tokens.usage: Greyscale app-icon tile, gradient start (top-left). Pair with `tile-mono-to` and the `mark-mono-*` greys. Used wherever the icon shares a light view with proof, and for the tinted/mono icon.

tokens.name: tile-mono-to
tokens.usage: Greyscale app-icon tile, gradient end (bottom-right). See `tile-mono-from`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Balance hero and big-bold moments. Tabular figures for money.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The money is set aside before the job starts.

styles.name: body-muted
styles.sample: Verify with your passport — it's optional, but it unlocks more.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, captions, status chips. Set IDs and reference numbers in the `mono` family at this size.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Website section eyebrows, uppercase, in `fg`. Never in the accent.

spacing.note: 4px base grid, from the app's spacing scale. Website section rhythm adds the two section steps.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges, icon optical offsets.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside chips; chip vertical padding is xs + 2.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; dot-to-text in chips.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding; compact list rows.

tokens.name: space-base
tokens.usage: Default card padding and screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Medium button horizontal padding; card padding on roomy cards.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Large button horizontal padding; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Gaps between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding panes.

tokens.name: space-huge
tokens.usage: Splash and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Website content section vertical padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-section-lg
tokens.usage: Website content section vertical padding (md and up).

radius.note: The Base Square's roundness at every size. Product UI never uses a hard rectangle.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny badges, focus outlines on small controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs on dense screens, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tiles and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xxl
tokens.usage: Sheets and large cards.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Phone-frame corners in web renditions (the Splash replay, app mockups). Not for product UI.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons (both sizes), status chips, FAB.

tokens.name: radius-web
tokens.usage: Website shadcn base `--radius` (0.625rem); its sm…4xl steps are multiples of it.

shadow.note: React Native shadows are platform-flaky: prefer borders, and elevation on Android.

tokens.name: shadow-card-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle lift on light-mode list cards.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Default card lift (light mode mostly; dark relies on `card-border`).

tokens.name: shadow-card-lg
tokens.usage: Raised cards and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: The floating action button only.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and controls.

tokens.name: opacity-texture-dark
tokens.usage: Obsidian texture layer on the dark website. Never below 0.3 or the texture vanishes.

tokens.name: opacity-texture-light
tokens.usage: Marble texture layer on the light website. Capped at 0.4 so the warm veining doesn't break the zero-chroma rule.
